title: the Rotwright as commander
hook: **the Rotwright** is the enemy commander — he runs his own war from his own fog while you hunt his fortress and guard the homeworld.

blindSpots.meaning: The opposing commander on the rift — not a lawn-only boss sprite and not a cheat that reads your save.
His capital sector. Taking it is the win condition — see [The game](^the-game.md).
the Garden Keeper’s capital. Losing it is losing the world.
He decides with incomplete information, same as you — fair opposing play.

alsoTrue: Enemy counter-development (the war shifting resists from how you play) is Vision — see [counter-development](counter-development).
Siege of the Seat is Vision as a finished stage — see [siege](siege).

sections.title: What it is
paras: the Rotwright is a real opponent on the map: he marches, claims, and pressures under his own fog.
Your job is to find his fortress and take it before yours falls.
sections.note: Win and lose are defined on [The game](^the-game.md) — keep who you are; the worlds you leave keep going.

cards.name: Orders
cards.body: He commits on the same End Turn resolve you do.

cards.name: Fog
cards.body: He does not peek at your save — he plays from uncertainty.

cards.name: Pressure
cards.body: Defend the homeworld while you hunt his fortress.

groups.title: On the World map
groups.intro: Advance, End Turn, and read what he did.
steps: Travel to World and expand through fog.
Press End Turn and watch opposing motion.
Treat fortress hunt and homeworld defence as the same war — not two separate modes.
groups.note: Richer ecology and counter-builds come later as Vision.

doSteps: Open the world map and note your homeworld.
End Turn at least once and look for opposing movement.
Keep expanding with homeworld safety in mind — losing it ends the world.
doNote: Stop when the Rotwright ≠ a scripted cutscene villain only. Related: [virtual turns](virtual-turns), [farm / hunt / defend](farm-hunt-defend).

mixUps.q: Does he see my whole roster?
mixUps.a: No. He evaluates from his fog.
Take the seat of the world’s dominant enemy empire before yours falls. The world keeps running after a win, and losing makes that world fallen — your save continues.
Siege as a tactical Seat board is Vision. Map pressure from the Rotwright already ships.

mixUps.q: Does he scale to my the Garden Keeper level only?
mixUps.a: Matched-level padding is not the design. Counter-development is Vision — see [counter-development](counter-development).
